title: Alerts center
subtitle: Triage, acknowledge and resolve alerts across all sites. Actions are saved for this browser session.
emptyBody: Nothing matches the current filters. That is usually good news.

runbooks.deviceDown: Check power and the upstream switch port, then confirm reachability from the site edge router.
runbooks.linkDown: Open a ticket with the carrier and confirm traffic has failed over to the backup link.
runbooks.cpuHigh: Identify the top processes or sessions; consider moving workload to the standby node.
runbooks.memHigh: Look for memory leaks or ballooning VMs; rebalance the cluster if needed.
runbooks.diskFull: Purge old logs or archives, or extend the volume before writes start failing.
runbooks.highLatency: Compare latency on the primary and backup paths and check for congestion on the WAN.
runbooks.packetLoss: Check interface errors and the carrier SLA probe; escalate if loss persists beyond 15 minutes.
runbooks.tempHigh: Verify cooling in the comms room and that fans are operating normally.
runbooks.upsOnBattery: Confirm the mains supply with facilities; prepare a graceful shutdown if runtime drops below 10 minutes.
runbooks.certExpiring: Renew the certificate and schedule deployment in the next change window.
runbooks.configChanged: Review the configuration diff and confirm there is an approved change request.
runbooks.backupFailed: Re-run the job and check repository capacity and credentials.
runbooks.interfaceFlapping: Inspect the cable/SFP and the connected device; consider disabling the port temporarily.
runbooks.bgpPeerDown: Check the peer's reachability and BGP timers; verify the carrier circuit status.
runbooks.appErrorRate: Review recent deployments and error logs for the service.
runbooks.appLatency: Check dependency latency (database, gateway) and recent traffic changes.
